mainEntity.name: What is the approximate cost per square foot for stucco installation or repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of stucco installation or repair per square foot varies widely depending on several factors. These include the type of stucco system (e.g., traditional three-coat, synthetic), the condition of the existing substrate, accessibility of the work area, geographic location, and any necessary prep work like old siding removal or structural repairs. New installation can range from $7 to $15 per square foot, while repairs might be quoted based on the extent of damage and labor involved. We offer detailed, itemized quotes after an on-site evaluation to provide an accurate estimate for your specific project.
